**Severity:** error · **Area:** Slots (`RV6xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
r:name must be a string literal naming a prop (an identifier)
```

```text
r:args must be an array literal: r:args={[item, index]}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Give `r:name` a string literal that is a valid identifier (`r:name`="header") and `r:args` an array literal (`r:args={[item, index]}`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A(props: any) { return <slot r:name="1x" />; }
```

```tsx prefer
export function A(props: any) { return <slot r:name="header" />; }
```
